faqs.a:
With reference to any sale in excess of the quantity provided in the preceding section
               of this article to any person under the age of 18 years, such seller shall, simultaneously
               with such sale, enter into a permanent record the date of said sale, the name, address,
               age and sex of each such purchaser, including the name and address of the consenting
               parent or guardian, intentional failure of which shall result in a violation of this
               article.
(Code 1981, § 21-58; Ord. No. 738, § 3, 10-21-1968)
